findings.finding: Runner identity is selected by the terminal itself. Any matching .github/scripts/*.py file and its own digest are accepted, including an unrelated no-op. The gate therefore does not bind execution to validate-v016-direct-upgrades.py or its pinned public-origin validation.
findings.remediation: Resolve the required canonical runner from trusted policy and compare the evidence path and digest to that runner; test an alternate existing script.

findings.finding: Rollback prestate and poststate may both be absent: None == None passes. The pristine-resume case never checks recovery at all, so never-resumed is accepted. Thus missing restoration and resume evidence passes the claimed exact recovery gate.
findings.remediation: Require nonempty valid SHA256 identities before comparing restoration; bind resume to its actual recovery result and transaction evidence. Add missing-both and wrong-resume tests.

findings.finding: Actual completion is accepted using only outcome/status flags. Target validation argv, timing, output digest/evidence, transaction identity and terminal duration/timestamps can all be missing. No retained execution evidence file is loaded or hashed. A hand-authored summary with no executed validation records passes, as does the current positive GWT031c fixture.
findings.remediation: Require a bounded actual-execution terminal schema and retained command/transaction evidence bindings, verify referenced evidence hashes and origin identities rather than accepting labels alone; test removed/corrupted retained evidence.

ci_findings: No separate wiring defect found: v0.16 step takes the same dist ZIP staged and validated above, supplies exact CANDIDATE_COMMIT, downloads three pinned-origin inputs for runner verification, and uploads execution output. This is source inspection, not hosted execution.

counterexample.result: Exact gate function accepted alternate no-op runner, missing rollback digests, wrong resume value and absent execution receipt/timing evidence.

limitations: No matrix, provider access or tracked changes. Another executor owns actual attempt4; its outcome is unknown to this review.
Counterexample executes only the exact extracted gate function against ignored local fixtures, not the full source-release pipeline.
